observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
TOKEN=$(cat alex_token.txt)
ROOM_ID=$(cat alex_room.txt)
ENC=$(python3 -c "import urllib.parse,sys;print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.argv[1],safe=''))" "$ROOM_ID")
echo "encoded room: $ENC"
echo "--- send message ---"
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"msgtype":"m.text","body":"Hello from Nebu install verification"}' \
  "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ENC/send/m.room.message/txn-verify-1" -w "\n[send: %{http_code}]\n"
echo "--- read back ---"
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ENC/messages?dir=b&limit=3" | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);[print(e['type'],'|',e.get('content',{}).get('body',e.get('content',{}).get('name',''))) for e in d['chunk']]"
